card.name: Words just before a time or distance span
card.fires_on: A word right before a stated interval, lead time, or distance, such as 'hours' after 48, 'approximately' before 12 hours apart, or 'once' before 'every 8 to 12 weeks'. Also 'located' before a distance.

modes.label: Dosing interval lead-in
modes.description: Words like approximately, once, or at just before an 'every X' or '12 hours apart' interval.

modes.label: Lead time or frequency in general text
modes.description: A time unit or frequency word before 'in advance', 'before', or 'every N years'.
modes.example: 97% of our DNA! Orangutans reproduce more slowly than any other primate, with the female producing a baby on average<< once>> every 7-8 years. Inf

modes.description: The word located before a measure of distance or depth.

card.writes: It pushes down words like late, beyond, close and distance words, so it seems to steer away from those after a time or distance lead-in.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before a stated time gap or distance, like 'approximately' before '12 hours apart'.
